definition: The group of words for what a style may say about one slot of its kit: it specifies the slot, extends it, leaves it open, or forbids it.
basis: schema/glossary-term.schema.json, the description of `family`, which lists the families in the order the Glossary page shows them: "`binding` holds what a style may say about one slot of its kit", and "Each value is bound by exactly one `family-<value>` record, whose term heads the group on the page."
